## 7. Business-plan-ready mission narrative

_Draft for founder review, composed only from the cited repository records._

**Mission.** Build a durable, founder-led AXES ecosystem that turns original design, creative work, origin intelligence, and accountable technology into supportable client services, products, and later platform offerings, while protecting the creative center of the work.

**Problem we are solving for ourselves first.** Founder meaning, origin, and ownership intent have repeatedly been captured after the fact instead of at the moment of direction; value is lost when directions, images, and definitions stay in chats or open PRs rather than in filed, canonical records.

**Assets on record.**

- Axes Contracting Inc, an existing California corporation with a CSLB contractor license recorded as active (re-verify before use)
- A governed monorepo with an accountable, allowlisted AI operations core (XIIOM/AXI) and a public portal
- Internal constitutional, creator-origin, and Genesis ownership records with AI non-personhood and external-action boundaries
- A preserved KEYSTONE founding corpus, origin anchor, and founder-claimed invention records
- A directive-vs-delivery accountability ledger and structural PR protocol

**Differentiators.**

- Origin-first provenance: every asset, agent, and decision is meant to carry source, owner, and correction history
- Truth labeling: symbolic, proposed, and verified material are kept separate
- Human authority: automation records, monitors, and proposes; it never spends, deploys, publishes, or signs

**Near-term revenue path.** Lead with AXES Contracting design/materials consultation (V2), then KEYSTONE creator-origin setup (V3); keep trading/URNUR (V1) non-revenue until legal scope exists.

**Sources.** [docs/AXES_BUSINESS_PLAN.md](../AXES_BUSINESS_PLAN.md); [docs/FOUNDER_REVENUE_PRIORITY_OVERLAY.md](../FOUNDER_REVENUE_PRIORITY_OVERLAY.md); [docs/AXES_CONTRACTING_REVENUE_LAUNCH_PLAN.md](../AXES_CONTRACTING_REVENUE_LAUNCH_PLAN.md); [docs/AXES_OBJECTIVES_CHECKPOINT.md](../AXES_OBJECTIVES_CHECKPOINT.md)
